Tucker Carlson said on Friday that if President Donald Trump is contemplating the use of nuclear weapons, he should be removed from office "immediately." He also questioned why no such action has been taken so far.

Carlson stated: "Any president who seriously considers the first use of nuclear weapons should be removed from office immediately. Immediately, because a nuclear strike that would destroy all of humanity is surely the red line." He further asked: "So why has no one tried to remove him immediately?"

The former Trump ally pointed out that, if asked, the White House would "claim the president has never recommended the use of nuclear weapons." But Carlson pushed back, saying this claim was "not true," because Trump has threatened to "totally destroy" Iran and its civilisation.

Carlson told his guest, former director of the US National Counterterrorism Centre Joe Kent (who resigned over his opposition to a war with Iran): "To completely destroy a civilisation, there is only one way, and that is to use nuclear weapons. Therefore, in public, in full view of the entire world ... the President of the United States has threatened the use of nuclear weapons in this war."

The podcast host said that anyone who advocates the offensive use of nuclear weapons is "dangerous, insane, and in fact a criminal."

Carlson said: "This man is essentially a madman, a dangerous madman, who not only should not have any decision-making power whatsoever, but should be imprisoned immediately — especially in a country that routinely throws people in jail for things like tax evasion."

He reiterated: "Any leader of any country, once they advocate the first use of nuclear weapons, has effectively forfeited their right to lead and must be removed from office immediately. Anyone who tolerates subordinates — or subordinates themselves — making such remarks is themselves unfit. After all, that would mean the total destruction of the world, right?"
